items.title: Important: libXi security update (CVE-2026-109089)
items.summary: A heap-based buffer overflow vulnerability (CVE-2026-109089) exists in the X.Org X11 libXi runtime library related to the DEVICERESOLUTION reply. This flaw could allow arbitrary code execution. A security update fixing this issue is available in libXi version 1.8.1-7.el102.3 for Red Hat Enterprise Linux 10 and related variants.

items.title: Important: kernel security update (CVE-2026-63922)
items.summary: A security update for the Linux kernel addresses multiple vulnerabilities including CVE-2026-63922, which involves refreshing the next header pointer after handling the IPv6 HAO option. The update fixes several other kernel issues such as use-after-free bugs and improper ownership management. The affected kernel versions are prior to 4.18.0-553.181.1.el810.

items.title: Important: ghostscript security update (CVE-2026-112177)
items.summary: A security vulnerability (CVE-2026-112177) in the Ghostscript suite affects versions prior to 9.27-20.el810 on Red Hat Enterprise Linux 8. The issue involves a reintroduction of a .charkeys -dSAFER bypass, which could allow unsafe PostScript code execution. A security update is available that fixes this vulnerability.
